ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the visible surface consists almost entirely of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with negligible high-intensity (white) areas.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid low-intensity pigmentation across both visible lobes; detection of two small, circular high-contrast (white) clusters located in the lower-central region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped convergence; the interior angle of the visible lobe intersection is approximately 55 degrees, though the vertex is occluded by water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge; peaks are more prominent and higher in pixel-amplitude on the left lobe than the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the right lobe leading to a sharp distal tip; left lobe displays a symmetrical convex sweep although partially obscured by perspective.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 2-3 localized circular high-contrast pixel clusters on the left lobe near the median notch area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Detection of organic matter or debris (macroalgae) trailing from the far-left lateral boundary of the fluke edge.
